description: This file defines a React component for the dashboard page of a web application. It imports dependencies, defines a StatCard component for displaying individual metrics, and a Dashboard component that fetches analytics data from an API and renders a layout with statistics and recent performance information.

methods.name: StatCard({ title, value, trend })
methods.description: A functional component that displays a metric card with title, value, and optional trend indicator.

methods.name: Dashboard()
methods.description: Main component that fetches dashboard analytics data and renders the dashboard layout with statistics and recent activity information.
